pages.title: Eschaton Core
pages.text: The heart of every last thing. Forged by hand in the reborn Core - and once you have, the Eschaton Foundry can make more.
The heart of every endgame artefact, and of each creative item the Forge makes.

Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Censer of Entropy, Crown of Transcendence, Dodecaract Excavator, Equilibrium Lattice, Eschaton Cell, Euclidean Anchor, Ex Nihilo Engine, Greaves of the Absolute and more.
